notes: The image is drawn with rows f-j in the upper half and a-e in the lower half, so I used bank 'b' for rows f-j (upper half in the image) and bank 't' for rows a-e (lower half in the image), to match each row letter. This is the opposite of the catalogue's top/bottom wording.
Pushbutton legs sit in columns 4 and 6 across the centre gap. I treated column 4 (both legs) as side 1, joined to the 5V rail. Column 6 is side 2, joined to pin 2 and the resistor.
The 10k pull-down resistor runs from column 6 to column 9. A short black wire takes column 9 to the bottom ground rail.
The red wire goes to the bottom plus rail (bp.1). The Arduino GND wire goes to the bottom minus rail (bn.1). Rail hole numbers are estimated from the pixel positions.
The Arduino GND wire lands on one of the two GND pins on the power header. I used GND.1.
The resistor is given value=10000 (10k ohm).
